caption:
Five things to do in Sayulita this April — in the order your day wants them:

🏄 Morning surf at Playa Los Muertos or La Lancha. Calm, steady breaks. Local instructors will have you up by day two.

🐋 Whale watching before they leave. Humpbacks are on the tail end of the season — a morning boat almost always turns up a tail slap or a breach.

🏝️ Marieta Islands day trip. The hidden beach inside the crater is bucket-list for a reason, and the snorkeling around the reefs is some of the best on the Pacific coast.

🥾 Hike Monkey Mountain before the heat. About 90 minutes up, with views all the way to San Pancho and Punta Mita.

🌮 Dinner at Don Pedro's with your feet in the sand. Order the mezcal. Stay for the sunset.

Dry season is at its peak. This is the month for all of it.
